annotations.text:
Director of Football — three directions for the mobile UI.

Top row is Home (the easy screen). Bottom row is the Squad list — the density test, because that is where the current build feels busiest.

Same data in all three: Man United, 4th, week 22, three pending decisions, eight squad rows.

FLOODLIGHT — recommended

Near-black neutral #0C0D10, Space Grotesk, one saturated accent (#C8FF4D) and the club colour as the only identity mark. No cards, no panel borders — hairline rules and whitespace do the grouping. One primary action per screen.

BROADSHEET

Warm paper #F6F2E9, Instrument Serif for numbers and names, Inter for data. Editorial: rules, a masthead, numbered desk items. Calm and distinctive; risks feeling slow, and light mode is worse for evening play.

TERMINAL

#08090B, JetBrains Mono for everything numeric, amber accent. Fixed columns, a persistent status strip, labels shortened. Densest of the three and the fastest to scan — but it reads as a tool, not a game.
